alerts.reason: Reported net sales growth slowed from +5.93% YoY in February to +2.18% in May. If that pace of slowing persists, growth would be about -1.6% in the intervening quarter and -5.3% in the target quarter, crossing the threshold. Fiscal 2023 volume fell 9% even as net sales rose (A, B), leaving sales exposed if pricing support fades.
